= camel generate wsdl

List the services, ports and operations of a WSDL, or scaffold a cxf route in PAYLOAD mode

NOTE: This command is provided by the `generate` plugin. Install it with `camel plugin add generate`.


== Usage

[source,bash]
----
camel generate wsdl [options]
----



== Options

[cols="2,5,1,2",options="header"]
|===
| Option | Description | Default | Type
| `--json` | Output the services, ports and operations in JSON Format, with the cxf endpoint options of each port |  | boolean
| `--operation` | The operations to list or scaffold (use commas to separate them; default: all) |  | String
| `--output` | The file to write the route to (default: stdout) |  | String
| `--port` | The port (its name), when the service has more than one |  | String
| `--route` | Scaffold a YAML route (consumer or producer) instead of listing the WSDL |  | String
| `--runtime` | The runtime the route is for (camel-main, spring-boot, quarkus): camel-main listens on the address of the WSDL, spring-boot and quarkus on its path in their CXF servlet | camel-main | RuntimeType
| `--service` | The service (its name), when the WSDL has more than one |  | String
| `-h,--help` | Display this help and exit |  | boolean
|===
